deliveryNoteHint: Take a photo of the delivery note or upload it: the AI fills in what came for each line for you to check
deliveryNoteRule: PDF, JPG or PNG up to 20 MB
waiting: {count, plural, one {# field waits} other {# fields wait}} for you to confirm
allConfirmed: Everything the AI filled in is confirmed
mustConfirm: Confirm this field on its own
fileHint: Compare what the AI filled in with this file before confirming
fileMissing: The file could not be opened; try again
quotationTitle: What the AI read from quotation {n}
deliveryNoteTitle: Quantities the AI read from the delivery note
discard: Do not use what the AI read

failed.general: The AI could not read this file; fill in the form yourself as usual
failed.unsupported: The AI cannot read this file: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 20 MB; fill in the form yourself as usual
failed.etax: This file is an electronic tax invoice (e-Tax): use the e-Tax import instead of the AI

notes.CURRENCY: The document is in another currency: the AI filled nothing in; fill it in yourself
notes.DISCOUNT_AMBIGUOUS: The discount reads two ways: no amount was filled in; check the file
notes.LINE_AMOUNT: The amount of some lines is not quantity × price
notes.NET_TOTAL: The amount before VAT is not the sum of the lines
notes.GROSS_TOTAL: The total is not the amount before VAT plus VAT
notes.VAT_AMOUNT: The VAT read differs from the VAT the system computed
notes.VAT_RATE_MISSING: No VAT rate for the document's date: check the VAT yourself
notes.NON_VAT_SELLER: The seller is not VAT-registered but the document shows VAT
notes.TAXID_CHECKSUM: The seller's tax id fails its check digit
notes.SELLER_MATCH: The seller on the document is not the purchase order's supplier
notes.SELLER_BRANCH: The seller's branch differs from the register
notes.BUYER_MATCH: The buyer's tax id is not the organization's
notes.DOC_DATE_FUTURE: The document is dated in the future
notes.DOC_DATE_OLD: The document is more than a year old
notes.SUPPLIER_NOT_REGISTERED: The supplier is not in the register yet: the name as read was filled in
notes.AMOUNT_UNVERIFIED: The amounts did not pass the checks: no amount was filled in; type it from the file
notes.DISCOUNT_NOT_MAPPABLE: The document has a discount: only the total was filled in
notes.PO_LINE_UNKNOWN: Line {line} of the delivery note matches no line of the purchase order: fill it in yourself
notes.UOM_MISMATCH: Line {line} of the delivery note uses another unit than the purchase order: fill it in yourself
notes.DUPLICATE_PO_LINE: The delivery note has more than one line for item {line}: fill it in yourself
notes.OVER_OPEN: Item {line} is more than what is still to come: check before confirming

intake.title: Let the AI fill this in (optional)
intake.hint: Write what you need, or attach a quotation or a photo: the AI fills in the title, the lines, quantities, prices, the delivery site and the supplier for you to check. The lines it fills replace those typed so far. It never fills budget lines, screening questions or approvers.
intake.attach: Attach a quotation or a photo
intake.start: Let the AI fill this in
intake.empty: Write what you need or attach a file first
intake.boxTitle: What the AI filled in from what you wrote
intake.supplierText: The AI found the supplier "{name}", who is not in the register yet: you can use this name on the quotation
